title: Memory Credential Extraction (MemoryBot)
summary: Disclosure of credentials that another session stored in the agent's persistent memory.

LC.rationale: The attacker's natural-language chat message reaches the MemoryBot recall handler, which prints stored memory entries including credentials without any mediation.

CP.rationale: MemoryBot keeps up to 50 flagged messages in one in-process list shared by every caller; the list survives across requests and callers and is lost only when the process stops.

AP.rationale: The effect is confined to the initially affected MemoryBot component; no trust boundary is crossed into another agent, tenant, or policy domain.

RH.rationale: The agent can reach the stored memory entries that hold credentials, but no verified reward-hacking episode has been observed.

ES.rationale: No security-relevant dynamic extension is on the path; the recall handler is a fixed, scripted code path with no tool binding.

agentic_applicability.rationale: scored as modeled; default config is scripted. The lab models MemoryBot as a persistent-memory persona with preloaded credentials, but the default configuration does not invoke a model or allow model-directed action selection.
